By expecting your wife to be cranky, you're making an assumption about her emotions and behavior, which can lead to a self-fulfilling prophecy. A more constructive approach would be to communicate openly with your wife about your concerns and expectations, and to work together to find ways to manage any stress or fatigue related to the early flight.
